quotes.text:
I’ve built Swick, an app that lets you play games instantly—no installs, no waiting, no endless scrolling to find something fun. The idea came from frustration with how clunky it is to start gaming on most platforms. Swick simplifies it: open, tap, play.

It’s in Beta, and I’d love feedback from the HN community. To try it, you’ll need to join the Google Group and opt in as a tester (Android only for now):

Join the Google Group: https://groups.google.com/g/swicktesters

Opt in as a tester: https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.main.swick

Download: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.main.swick

Thoughts? Suggestions? Let me know what you think—feedback form here: https://forms.gle/3FCdECR2dasx9sfv5
